test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The couple / preferred to walk / until the last house / of the town.
solution:
The correct answer is ‘3’ i.e. until the last house.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'until the last house' is incorrect in this context.
 
 
• The correct phrase should be **'up to the last house.'**
 
 
 
• The other segments are grammatically correct.
 
 
• **'The couple'** correctly refers to two people acting together.
 
• **'Preferred to walk'** correctly indicates their choice of activity.
 
• **'Of the town'** correctly indicates the location in question.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *The couple preferred to walk up to the last house of the town.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using 'until' often implies a continuation of action up to a point in time, while 'up to' is more appropriate for physical distances or locations.
 
 
• **Example:** *We walked up to the park entrance.*
